Added work_checkpoint.resolve_canonical_repo(), made --repo optional and auto-resolved via 'git rev-parse --git-common-dir', and corrected CLAUDE.md. No agent now hardcodes the canonical path.

Added it to .gitignore; _git_snapshot uses --exclude-standard so the loop is now closed.
continuity_defects_repaired_by_claude_co.CODEX_ACCEPTANCE_TEST_LEFT_UNCOMMITTED_A: test_codex_claude_codex_provenance_handoff_preserves_authority_and_action is the acceptance criterion for round-trip takeover. continuity_defects_repaired_by_claude_co.PEER_CONSULTATION_PUBLISHED_ACCOUNT_IDEN: scripts/agent/claude_peer_bridge.py captured the full 'claude auth status --json' output into a committed provenance artifact. Its _SENSITIVE_KEY denylist did not cover email, orgId, orgName or projectsDirectory, so the committed docs/agent/peer_consultations/claude_smoke_20260905/CLAUDE_PEER_CONSULTATION.json carried account identity and the local username toward a public repository. Replaced the denylist with an allowlist (_AUTH_SUMMARY_KEYS), added _redact_user_paths, widened the denylist, removed the artifact, and purged it from unpushed branch history before first push.
